hypothesis: Use raw witnesses for rounded-softcap winners to skip transformations that cannot beat the current fifth entry, preserving all ties.

memory_and_programs.host_state: five winner IDs/scores plus five raw witnesses; no per-token heap allocation

timing.on_overrun: record overrun; join safely; never kill an accelerator child

acceptance.performance: Reject on control drift >5%, nonpositive paired gain, changed work counts, unpinned inputs, any oracle failure, or inconsistent stratum. Retain all repetitions. A positive screen is provisional until independent confirmation; no automatic promotion.

experiment: Run the exhaustive finite-half native host test including reversed/permuted streams, signed zero and saturation counterexample. Replay captured head logits and require identical five token IDs and score bits, not only top1. Use --head-ranking-timing true on BOTH baseline and candidate timing arms; report considered=262144 and transformed+pruned=considered each successful step. The optional CPU timer excludes all ANE head project/surface calls. Full-model 84-token/10-output ABBA with the same compiled programs, binary and power stratum; no CPU-cycle normalization of device time.
risks: Native FP32 tanh/FP16 transform monotonicity must pass the supplied exhaustive finite-half test.
Adversarial ascending streams prune little; synthetic pruning counts are not a performance result.
incompatibility: One performance candidate per arm. Do not combine new candidates with each other or the original six until individual effects are independently established.

component_screen.oracle: Native Rust exhaustive finite-half monotonicity plus ascending, reversed and fixed-permutation streams; compare rounded-score bits and stable tokenIDs to independent all-transform stable sort.
component_screen.timing: --head-ranking-timing true on both full-route arms. Timer encloses CPU ranking only, not head.project. transformed+pruned must equal considered=262144 per step.
component_screen.adapter_status: Runtime CLI and host oracle supplied. Captured-logit timing adapter is local-only; no new ANE program required.
